zh.name: 相似概念对照指南
zh.summary: 将两个容易混淆的概念放在同样情境下逐项比较，让差别落到可观察表现。
zh.useWhen: 比较维度固定；不把任何两种商品并排就算作本模板。
zh.instructions: 两个概念、可靠定义、同一维度的例子或图像
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Similar Concepts Compared
en.summary: Create an Instagram reference carousel using the similar concepts compared structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the similar concepts compared format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
